author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies three or more hosts resolving command and control domains used by the Frosted Ratchet infostealer, as reported in campaign PTF-01590. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Frosted Ratchet Infostealer: Several hosts resolving command and control domains (PTF-01590)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Frosted Ratchet Infostealer: Several hosts resolving command and control domains

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Frosted Ratchet infostealer in campaign PTF-01590.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query:
FROM logs-endpoint.events.network-*
| WHERE dns.question.name IN ("cdn-relay54.invalid", "connect-track33.example", "data-track76.invalid", "edge-cdn11.invalid", "media-secure97.example", "relay-secure33.test", "auth-mail152.example", "mail-mail126.invalid")
| STATS host_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.id), hosts = VALUES(host.name) BY dns.question.name
| WHERE host_count >= 3
